import base64, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
payload = base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == '79b407d699b5fd39e7b396de8b6fc79b2bc2fb99f427f7e2e7ecd25fbc71fb0b'
Path('submission.tar.gz').write_bytes(payload)
print('Exact artifact written; SHA256', hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
